items.title: Champagne Maker Taittinger Sells More to a World That’s Drinking Less
items.why: Premium champagne demand is holding up better than overall drinking trends, a signal for affluent spend on indulgent categories.
items.summary_ai: Taittinger reports continued sales growth even as global alcohol consumption declines.
items.take: Premium champagne demand is holding up better than overall drinking trends, a signal for affluent spend on indulgent categories.
